title: Projective cofibrancy of the enriched free bar diagonal
statement:
Use small simplicial categories of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], simplicial sets and the simplex category of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and enriched projective model structures of [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]. Fix one universe for all object sets and simplicial sets. Let $A$ be any small simplicial category and $X:A\to\mathsf{sSet}$ an enriched functor. Define a simplicial object $P_\bullet X$ in enriched covariant $A$-modules by
$$P_nX(b)=\coprod_{a_0,\ldots,a_n}X(a_0)\times A(a_0,a_1)\times\cdots\times A(a_{n-1},a_n)\times A(a_n,b).$$
The action in $b$ postcomposes the last factor. For $n\geq1$, the first face applies the $X$-action, an interior face composes the corresponding adjacent mapping factors, and the last face composes the final two mapping factors. Degeneracies insert an identity between the displayed vertices $a_i$ (including the last vertex $a_n$). These operators commute with the internal simplicial operators. Let $Q_AX$ be its objectwise diagonal, so
$$(Q_AX(b))_r=(P_rX(b))_r.$$
Equivalently $Q_AX=\int^{[n]\in\Delta}P_nX\times\Delta^n$, with the quotient imposing $(P(\alpha)z,t)\sim(z,\alpha t)$ for every simplex operator $\alpha$ and compatible $z,t$. Then $Q_AX$ is projectively cofibrant as an enriched $A$-module. The assertion holds for arbitrary $X$, including empty values, and does not require the mapping simplicial sets of $A$ to be Kan.
